name: Krenko, Mob Boss
flavorText: "Threats? Extortion? Good sir, you have me all wrong. I am a legitimate businessman; my colleagues and I are simply here to conduct legitimate business."

name: Sauron, the Dark Lord
setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

name: Kaalia of the Vast
flavorText: In the vast emptiness, Kaalia found she was not alone.

name: Fire Lord Azula
flavorText: "I'm sorry it has to end this way, brother."

name: Giada, Font of Hope
flavorText: Now she is New Capenna's greatest hope.

name: Pantlaza, Sun-Favored
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
flavorText: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

name: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Wizard // Legendary Creature — Avatar Wizard

name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Avatar Soldier // Legendary Creature — Angel Nightmare Avatar

name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
flavorText: Trained by the Imperials but disillusioned by their rigidity, he gave his heart—and his swords—to the Asari Uprising.

name: Miirym, Sentinel Wyrm
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Hashaton, Scarab's Fist
flavorText: "I served the Scarab in an age long past, in another form, under another name. No matter their visage, I serve."

name: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge
flavorText: "I know this world, from canopy to roots."

name: Hakbal of the Surging Soul
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
flavorText:
"My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed."
—Multani

name: Aragorn, the Uniter
setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

name: Kuja, Genome Sorcerer // Trance Kuja, Fate Defied
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Mutant Wizard // Legendary Creature — Avatar Wizard
flavorText: "Peace is but a shadow of death, desperate to forget its painful past..."

name: Flubs, the Fool
flavorText: He knows exactly where he's going and exactly how he isn't getting there.

synergyCards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

name: Teysa Karlov
flavorText: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

name: Arabella, Abandoned Doll
flavorText: Every night, Cori threw the unsettling doll away. Every morning, it was back on the shelf, its eyes following her every move.

name: Tom Bombadil
setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
flavorText: Transformed at his own wedding, he promptly ate the banquet, the gifts, and the guests.

name: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Avatar Ally // Legendary Creature — Avatar Ally
flavorText: When the world needed him most, the Avatar returned.

name: Terra, Magical Adept // Esper Terra
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Wizard Warrior // Legendary Enchantment Creature — Saga Wizard

name: Kilo, Apogee Mind
flavorText: Both sculptor and sculpted.

name: Norman Osborn // Green Goblin
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Scientist Villain // Legendary Creature — Goblin Human Villain

name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
flavorText: "Hush now. I need your beauty sleep."

name: Hope Estheim
flavorText: "If we have the power to destroy Cocoon, then we have the power to save it."

name: Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch
setName: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander

name: Captain N'ghathrod
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
flavorText: "You're living on borrowed time."

name: Deadpool, Trading Card
flavorText: "Draw me like one of your French cards."

name: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Elder Dinosaur // Legendary Creature — Phyrexian Elder Dinosaur

name: Zur the Enchanter
flavorText: Zur remained aloof from Terisiare's suffering, intent only on his own perfection.

name: Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait
flavorText:
"To sail through those waters is to offer oneself as tribute."
—Captain Hoyrik

name: Alela, Artful Provocateur
flavorText: "Rankle's pranks are child's play. My games will topple kingdoms."

name: Kynaios and Tiro of Meletis
flavorText: "Look what we fought for. Look what we built together."

name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
flavorText: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"

name: Tifa Lockhart
flavorText: "I'm pretty good at taking care of myself, you know."

name: Zada, Hedron Grinder
flavorText: "A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."

name: Tovolar, Dire Overlord // Tovolar, the Midnight Scourge
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Werewolf // Legendary Creature — Werewolf

name: Brago, King Eternal
flavorText: "My rule persists beyond death itself."

name: Lightning, Army of One
flavorText: "Lightning. It flashes bright, then fades away. It can't protect. It only destroys."

name: Kykar, Wind's Fury
flavorText: "The raging gale fans the flames of righteous wrath."

name: Marrow-Gnawer
flavorText: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night. Now they call him their first lord.

name: Cosmic Spider-Man
flavorText: The Enigma Force granted Peter the greatest power, and with it, the greatest responsibility.

name: Sythis, Harvest's Hand
flavorText: "Through every verdant field, every bough that hangs heavy with fruit, Karametra shows her love."

name: Temmet, Naktamun's Will
flavorText: Each time he glimpsed oblivion, he learned another lesson.

name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
flavorText: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice, a will so disciplined that it dispenses justice without ego or remorse.

name: Tiamat
flavorText: "My children will rule over all!"

name: Fire Lord Zuko
flavorText: "Today, this war is finally over!"

name: Shelob, Child of Ungoliant
setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

name: Doran, Besieged by Time
flavorText: "Each year that passes rots you with scars. Shelter your heart, for the world is cruel."

name: Rocco, Street Chef
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

name: Blech, Loafing Pest
flavorText: Despite Blex's passing, Witherbloom students still continued the tradition of a yearly search in his honor. His son, however, took little effort to find.

name: Shroofus Sproutsire
flavorText: His laughter—and everything else about him—was infectious.

name: Yarok, the Desecrated
flavorText:
"Yarok grieves within the waste
Of Bala Ged's corrupted land."
—*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1

synergyCards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

name: Jon Irenicus, Shattered One
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern
flavorText: Fear is her one true companion.

name: Yurlok of Scorch Thrash
flavorText: The gifts of Jund never come without a price.

name: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer
flavorText: "You are a sickness on this city. I am the cure!"

name: Hazel of the Rootbloom
flavorText: "May all your caches be full."

name: Judith, Carnage Connoisseur
flavorText: "I don't make my living hiding the truth, detective. I shout it from the stage."

name: Sheoldred, the Apocalypse
flavorText: "Gix failed. I shall not."

name: Kraum, Ludevic's Opus
flavorText:
"It lives . . . IT LIVES!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

synergyCards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

name: The Mindskinner
flavorText: It slices away the most precious memories first, then the mundane, until all that remains is blank, formless fear.

name: Saruman, the White Hand
flavorText: Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.

name: Zimone, Infinite Analyst
flavorText: "The best answers leave you with more questions."

name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
flavorText: Beneath crashing waves lies an ocean of secrets waiting to be explored.

name: Alania, Divergent Storm
flavorText: "Why would I chase the storm? Does a cloud chase the rain? Does the sun chase the light?"

name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
flavorText: She's got a heart of gold, a nose for danger, and jaws that can pulverize a cellarspawn with a single snap.

name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice
flavorText: There are no soloists in the chorus of Selesnya.

name: Child of Alara
flavorText: The progeny of the Maelstrom shows no allegiance—and no mercy—to any of the five shards.

name: Sliver Overlord
flavorText: The end of evolution.

name: Clavileño, First of the Blessed
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Ob Nixilis, Captive Kingpin
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
flavorText: Stranded on New Capenna without a spark, he faced five families out for blood.

name: Thranduil, the Elvenking
flavorText: In a great hall with pillars hewn out of the living stone sat the Elvenking on a chair of carven wood.

name: Ketramose, the New Dawn
flavorText: Let the past die so the future might live.

name: Tannuk, Steadfast Second
flavorText: "We're a few bones short of a skeleton crew, Sami, but we've got plenty of spine."

name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
flavorText: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

name: Volo, Guide to Monsters
flavorText: "The beholder told me I had a good eye for details. Who was I to argue?"

name: Katara, the Fearless
flavorText: "I will never, ever turn my back on people who need me!"

name: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power
Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Hero Villain // Legendary Creature — Symbiote Hero Villain
flavorText: "I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together..."

name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
flavorText: The earth walks, strongest of all.

name: Shiko and Narset, Unified
flavorText: For peace, lead by example.

name: Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer
flavorText: They wouldn't admit it, but some people join the Cabaretti just for the food.

name: Nicol Bolas, the Ravager // Nicol Bolas, the Arisen
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Elder Dragon // Legendary Planeswalker — Bolas

name: Omnath, Locus of Mana
flavorText: It gathers against the coming storm.

name: Kudo, King Among Bears
flavorText: Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.

name: Queza, Augur of Agonies
flavorText: Some try to unravel the tangled skeins of fate. She reweaves them to her own deadly design.

name: Shalai and Hallar
flavorText: Between the angel's blade and the elf's bow, few Phyrexians made it as far as Llanowar's canopy.

name: Tannuk, Memorial Ensign
flavorText: Serving in the Memorial Navy was nothing like the posters made it out to be.

name: Tatyova, Benthic Druid
flavorText: "Yavimaya is one being—one vastness of rippling leaves, one deepness of roots, and one chatter of animals—of which I am one part."

name: Jodah, Archmage Eternal
flavorText:
"Chronicles across the ages describe Jodah. They likely refer not to one mage, but to a family or an arcane title."
—Arkol, Argivian scholar

name: Noctis, Prince of Lucis
flavorText: Many sacrificed all for the King; so must the King sacrifice himself for all.

name: Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh
flavorText: Strength is relative.

name: Rowan, Scion of War
flavorText: "No more days withering at a negotiating table with my brother. I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power."

name: Reaper King
flavorText: It's harvest time.

name: Norin the Wary
flavorText: "I have a bad feeling about this."

name: Syr Gwyn, Hero of Ashvale
flavorText: Squires throughout the realm aspire to her mix of panache and martial prowess.

name: Raggadragga, Goreguts Boss
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Kalamax, the Stormsire
flavorText: Its mood changes with the weather, and vice versa.

name: Obeka, Brute Chronologist
flavorText: "I'm bored with now."

name: Elas il-Kor, Sadistic Pilgrim
flavorText: "All will bow to the Whispering One."

name: Xenagos, God of Revels
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Kess, Dissident Mage
flavorText: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

name: Vnwxt, Verbose Host
flavorText: "Racers! Start! Your! Engiiiiiines!"

name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
flavorText: "With the right tools, even the sky is within reach."

name: Neriv, Heart of the Storm
flavorText: Scales streaked with lightning, trailing thunder in his wake, Neriv is the living banner around which the Mardu rally.

name: The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl
flavorText: "We're here to eat nuts and kick butts!"

name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
flavorText: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

name: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Scientist Hero // Legendary Creature — Gamma Berserker Hero
flavorText: "You shouldn't make me angry . . ."

name: Sen Triplets
flavorText: They are the masters of your mind.

name: Ozai, the Phoenix King
flavorText: "Out of the ashes, a new world will be born."

name: Kellan, the Kid
flavorText: "I found out who I was. Now it's time to discover who I am."

name: Niv-Mizzet, Visionary
flavorText: Ravnica's sharpest mind and its biggest ego.

name: Xavier Sal, Infested Captain
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
flavorText: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."

name: Tuvasa the Sunlit
flavorText: "My people have always been here, and here we shall remain."

name: Tony Stark // The Invincible Iron Man
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Artificer Hero // Legendary Artifact Creature — Human Hero

name: Myrkul, Lord of Bones
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Gisa and Geralf
flavorText:
"These fiends are slightly less tolerable than you."
"A sentiment that warms my heart, sister."

name: Lathiel, the Bounteous Dawn
flavorText: Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.

name: Gluntch, the Bestower
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Admiral Brass, Unsinkable
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar
flavorText: "Join me for the dawn of a new age."

name: Sméagol, Helpful Guide
setName: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

name: Sigarda, Font of Blessings
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

name: Kadena, Slinking Sorcerer
flavorText: "The only constant in life is the unknown."

name: Thantis, the Warweaver
flavorText: She spins a web few can resist. Its sweet aroma sparks chaos in every heart.

name: Clive, Ifrit's Dominant // Ifrit, Warden of Inferno
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Noble Warrior // Legendary Enchantment Creature — Saga Demon

name: Ayula, Queen Among Bears
flavorText: Born from the oldest red cedar, nursed on the sap of the tallest spruce, coronated under the mightiest pine.

name: Pramikon, Sky Rampart
flavorText: Its colors entrance aggressors, directing their violence.

name: Bruvac the Grandiloquent
flavorText: ". . . and furthermore . . ."

name: Kiora, Sovereign of the Deep
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
flavorText: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

name: Ardbert, Warrior of Darkness
flavorText: "Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?"

name: Zurgo, Thunder's Decree
flavorText: "Hear me, Mardu! Our freedom is only beginning!"

name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
flavorText: "I do not miss Jukai Forest. It is not my home. My home is Kamigawa, its people my family. Wherever I set my pack and rest my head, I am home."

name: Jasmine Boreal of the Seven
flavorText: "I've had my adventures. All I wish now is to sit in peace and speak with the pines."

name: Rootha, Mastering the Moment
flavorText: "The great thrill of perfection is that we'll always be chasing it."

name: Ral, Monsoon Mage // Ral, Leyline Prodigy
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Wizard // Legendary Planeswalker — Ral

name: Wayta, Trainer Prodigy
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander

name: Kwain, Itinerant Meddler
flavorText: "Why so slow, why so slow? Hurry up! You never know what you'll find."

name: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Kithkin Warrior // Legendary Creature — Kithkin Soldier

name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain
flavorText: As she took the wheel of the *Weatherlight* for the first time in a millennium, Jhoira knew she'd been right to restore the ship. Anything was possible now.

name: Marisi, Breaker of the Coil
flavorText: "Cast off the law! Awaken your rage!"

name: Duskana, the Rage Mother
flavorText:
"A pale bear shall herald the rise of the old gods."
—Gruul prophecy

name: Hinata, Dawn-Crowned
flavorText: Hope races on sunlit hooves.

name: Talrand, Sky Summoner
flavorText: "The seas are vast, but the skies are even more so. Why be content with one kingdom when I can rule them both?"

name: Ognis, the Dragon's Lash
flavorText: Ziatora's second-in-command has a habit of appearing when and where her enemies least expect her.

name: Astarion, the Decadent
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
flavorText: Her centuries-long search is ended.

name: Juri, Master of the Revue
flavorText: "What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."

name: Ixhel, Scion of Atraxa
setName: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander

name: Eshki Dragonclaw
flavorText: "The Twice Whisperer heals. The Dragonclaw protects. Together, we will rebuild the Temur."

name: Nahiri, Forged in Fury
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
flavorText: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

name: Peter Parker // Amazing Spider-Man
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Scientist Hero // Legendary Creature — Spider Human Hero
flavorText: "This batch of web fluid will just have to wait!"

name: Narci, Fable Singer
flavorText: "All stories eventually come to an end."

name: Don Andres, the Renegade
setName: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
flavorText: "Why climb the tangled rigging of the Legion of Dusk's hierarchy when I can fly a free flag of my own?"

name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
flavorText: "You should have folded when you had the chance."

name: Aang, at the Crossroads // Aang, Destined Savior
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Avatar Ally // Legendary Creature — Avatar Ally

name: Karador, Ghost Chieftain
flavorText: "Death tried to uncrown me. But now I return, king of a greater realm."

name: Abaddon the Despoiler
flavorText: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
flavorText: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

name: Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan
flavorText: "Through perennation, we stand together, families—ancestor and kin─united as one clan! Abzan!"

name: Imodane, the Pyrohammer
flavorText: "The realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king."

name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
flavorText: It's hard to say which is more deadly: her bike or her bite.

name: Aragorn, King of Gondor
flavorText: "In this place will I abide, and my heirs, unto the ending of the world."

name: The Emperor of Palamecia // The Lord Master of Hell
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Noble Wizard // Legendary Creature — Demon Noble Wizard

name: Sorin of House Markov // Sorin, Ravenous Neonate
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Human Noble // Legendary Planeswalker — Sorin

synergyCards.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
typeLine: Legendary Enchantment Creature — God // Legendary Enchantment Creature — Phyrexian God
flavorText:
"*Compleat* the faith, *compleat* the god."
—Ajani Goldmane

name: Whtz, the Bibliophile
flavorText: Created to keep the library well-stocked.

name: Teval, Arbiter of Virtue
flavorText: "As you act, so shall you be judged."

name: Slimefoot, the Stowaway
flavorText: As Jhoira restored the *Weatherlight*, a mushroom growing in its hold unexpectedly became her first crew member.

name: Maha, Its Feathers Night
flavorText: Its wingspan reaches from dusk to dawn.

name: Karn, Legacy Reforged
setName: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

name: Anhelo, the Painter
flavorText: Every work of art is a hit.

name: The Reaper, King No More
flavorText: Harrowed but still harrowing.

name: Kelsien, the Plague
flavorText: "Aim for an eye. Better they never see you."

name: Nine-Fingers Keene
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Mister Negative
flavorText: "Light and dark. They are in opposition, but both are necessary. I am both, and so I am all."

name: Anzrag, the Quake-Mole
flavorText: His claws tear at the foundations of civilization.

name: Elminster
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons
flavorText: Her subtle smile is suffused with venom.

name: Felix Five-Boots
flavorText: Multiple pseudopods and no vital organs make dueling a whole lot easier.

name: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff
typeLine: Legendary Snow Creature — God // Legendary Snow Artifact
flavorText: "Wherever snow falls, I am home."

name: Progenitus
flavorText: The Soul of the World has returned.

name: Ashling, Rekindled // Ashling, Rimebound
typeLine: Legendary Creature — Elemental Sorcerer // Legendary Creature — Elemental Wizard

name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
flavorText: "The echo of silence is music to my ears."

name: Tasha, the Witch Queen
setName: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate

name: Averna, the Chaos Bloom
flavorText: "Nature is a dance. Master it, and the world can keep no secrets from you."

name: Massacre Girl, Known Killer
flavorText: "'Did I do it?' You'll have to be more specific."

name: Karlov of the Ghost Council
flavorText: "Does Teysa think me blind to her scheming? Ambition runs in our family."

name: Uril, the Miststalker
flavorText: It strides through the whitecover, mists in which even gargantuans can hide.

name: Hamza, Guardian of Arashin
flavorText: "I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."

name: Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second
flavorText: She watches Jetmir's back while her companions watch hers.
